verdict.rationale: Bolna documents an official Web Call SDK under its developer-resources/sdks section, which connects a browser tab to a Bolna voice agent. Its documented scope is browser voice sessions only. The rest of the platform is evidenced through the REST API, CLI and MCP server, which are separate capabilities. missing for 10: server-side language SDKs (e.g., Python/Node) for managing agents and calls, SDK reference depth (install, versioning, typed clients), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Web Call SDK connects a browser tab directly to a Bolna voice agent for a live, two-way conversation.
Drop live, spoken conversations with a Bolna voice agent into any web page. One class, six events, no telephony expertise required.
